zh: 增强智能体长期记忆溯源与并发保护：新增记忆来源与版本追溯（`memory source`，支持在个人对话回查出处并隔离共享会话），支持“仅限本次/不记入长期记忆”临时例外拦截，以及防重复/防覆盖并发校验。
完善个人记忆交互引导与工具上下文注入：向智能体透传当前消息来源与共享状态，涉及记忆查询、修改或遗忘时优先使用 `memory` 工具并如实反馈写入结果。
en: Enhanced agent long-term memory provenance and concurrency safety: added versioned source tracing (`memory source` in personal chats, isolated from shared sessions), temporary-only exception guards, and atomic insert/update checks.
Improved memory tool guidance and turn context wiring by passing current message source metadata and shared-turn flags so memory lookups and updates rely directly on `memory` tool results.
